label: Angled Box Pleat Patch
description: The angled box-pleat patch pocket combines an angular, typically asymmetric upper edge — cut on a rake that mirrors the jacket's natural chest angle — with a central box pleat running down the face of the patch to allow the pocket to open and carry a square with ease. The angled cut prevents the pocket from reading as flat or uniform, and the box pleat adds gentle volume and a subtle country-sporting quality. It is particularly well suited to shooting and hacking jackets in tweed or heavy worsted where functionality and rugged elegance are equally prized.
